purpose: Charges for changing direction.
situation: A route reaches its goal by the right general course but zigzags between neighbouring Vtx the whole way there.

name: Heuristics : Least Nodes
purpose: Charges the same amount for every step, whatever it spans.
situation: Every stop along a route costs something and the distance between stops does not, as with transfers, waypoints or anything paid for per hop.

name: Heuristics : Shortest Distance
purpose: Charges for length.
situation: A route should take the shortest way across a cluster, or should treat length as one cost among several.

name: Heuristics : Steepness
purpose: Charges for slope.
situation: A route over uneven ground should stay level, or should climb, and the shortest line does neither.

name: Heuristics : Tensor
purpose: Charges for disagreeing with a field.
situation: A field already describes which way things should run through this space, and a route across a cluster should obey it.

name: Heuristics : Turn Penalty
purpose: Charges for the corner between one step and the next, in degrees, with a tolerance band at each end.
situation: A route may bend as much as it likes up to some angle and must never exceed another, as with anything that has a turning radius.

name: Filter : Inclusion (Path/Splines)
purpose: Answers whether each element falls inside a shape drawn by path-like data.
situation: A spline or a closed path marks out a region, and whether an element survives depends on falling within it.

name: Edge Filter : Edge Direction
purpose: Judges an edge by which way it runs.
situation: A cluster whose edges run in every direction, and the node downstream should only see the ones within some angle of a chosen axis.

name: Iterations
purpose: Emits a chosen number of empty datasets so a loop node has something to iterate over.
situation: A subgraph that has to run a fixed number of times, where the count is a setting rather than a property of the incoming data.

name: Laplacian (Poisson)
purpose: Places every Vtx on the average position of the Vtx it shares an edge with.
situation: A cluster whose Vtx sit at uneven intervals along its chains, where regular spacing is worth more than the outline.

name: Collection | Level
purpose: A collection whose entries are level assets, so one pick places a whole arrangement instead of one asset.
situation: A level was dressed by hand and now has to be placed repeatedly, as one weighted option among others.

name: Level Data Exporter
purpose: Level export is a replaceable step, and this is the class that replaces it.
situation: A project needs its levels captured on its own terms, and the shipped exporter's rules are not those terms.

name: Lloyd Relax 2D
purpose: Evens out a scatter on a plane rather than in a volume.
situation: Points scattered across terrain that should read as evenly spread when seen from above, without the ground's slope pulling them together.

name: Lloyd Relax 3D
purpose: Evens out a scatter by repeatedly moving each point to the middle of the space it owns.
situation: A random scatter that reads as blotchy and needs to look evenly spread without becoming a grid.

name: Cluster : Make Unique
purpose: Gives each cluster passing through it a pair id nothing else shares.
situation: One cluster was fanned out to several branches, each branch did something of its own, and the results are about to arrive on one pin together.

name: Match Rule Definition
purpose: The base every Match : node inherits.
situation: Reading any Match : page and needing to know what Strictness actually changes, or how three rules on one pin add up to a single yes or no.

name: Filter : Mean
purpose: Judges each element against a statistic of the data it sits in rather than against a number you set.
situation: A dataset where what counts as too long, too dense or too far is only definable against the rest of it.

name: Merge Points
purpose: Collapses several point datasets into one, or into one per group when the matching rules say which datasets belong together.
situation: Many datasets that have to become one before something that reasons over the whole set, with the per-dataset identity preserved somehow rather than lost.

name: Cluster : Merge Vtx
purpose: Collapses several Vtx datasets into one, so every cluster that arrives ends up sharing a single Vtx dataset.
situation: Clusters that came from separate generators, or were partitioned earlier, have to be handed to something that reads one Vtx dataset.

name: Collection | Mesh
purpose: A weighted list of static meshes, where each entry also carries the component settings and the material variants its mesh spawns with.
situation: A prop library that scatters as instanced meshes, where a handful of entries need to come out in more than one material.

name: Staging Data
purpose: Instanced-mesh spawning is what the vanilla Static Mesh Spawner already does, and this is what teaches it to read staged picks.
situation: A staged dataset reaches a Static Mesh Spawner, and the meshes have to come out with the descriptors, tags and material variants their collections authored.

name: Mesh to Clusters
purpose: Reads a static mesh asset and hands back its topology as a cluster, once per target point.
situation: A static mesh already carries the connectivity wanted, and it has to become cluster data at one or more places in the world.

name: Meta Cleanup
purpose: Deletes attributes and tags by name, with two independent name filters and string matching rather than an exact list.
situation: A subgraph is about to return data carrying a dozen intermediate attributes nobody downstream should see.

name: Sort Points
purpose: Reorders the points inside each dataset by a stack of rules wired in as sub-nodes.
situation: Points that arrived in whatever order a generator produced, and need a deliberate order before something downstream reads them as a sequence.

name: Filter : Modulo Compare
purpose: Divides a value by a base and tests what is left over, which is how a repeating pattern becomes a pass or fail.
situation: Every Nth element of an ordered set, or every value that lands near a multiple of some angle or spacing.

name: Move Pivot
purpose: Moves a point's origin somewhere else inside its own bounds, without moving what the bounds enclose.
situation: Points that need to sit on the ground by their base rather than by their middle, before anything spawns or samples from them.

name: Moving Average
purpose: Averages a run of consecutive points around each point.
situation: A path whose points are noisy step to step and whose order is meaningful, a traced or generated run where near in the sequence is what near should mean.

name: Filter : Check Nearest
purpose: Redirects the question to a different point.
situation: Whether an element survives depends on what the point nearest to it looks like, not on anything the element itself carries.

name: Sampler : Vtx Blend
purpose: Blends attribute values from a Vtx's neighbours back onto it.
situation: Values that should even out along connections, or spread outward from where they were authored.

name: Sampler : Test Neighbors
purpose: Counts how many of a Vtx's neighbours pass a test.
situation: Vtx that should be classified by what surrounds them rather than by anything they carry themselves.

name: Sampler : Abstract
purpose: The base every Sampler sub-node inherits, and the page for the settings they all share.
situation: Reading one of the Sampler nodes and needing to know which of its settings are its own and which reach it from here.

name: Vtx Filter : Adjacency
purpose: Judges a Vtx by the numbers carried on the things it touches.
situation: A cluster where the test that matters is against the neighbourhood: above every neighbour, below their average, or matching enough of them.

name: Vtx Filter : Edge Angle
purpose: Sorts a Vtx by how sharply the cluster turns at it.
situation: A chain of Vtx running through a cluster, where the corners have to be told apart from the straight runs.

name: Vtx Filter : Edge Direction
purpose: Judges a Vtx by where its edges point.
situation: A cluster where the Vtx worth keeping are the ones whose connections head a particular way: uphill, along an authored flow vector, or along the Vtx facing.

name: Vtx Filter : Num Edges
purpose: Tests how many edges reach a Vtx.
situation: A cluster where the next node should act on the leaves, on the junctions, or on the runs between them.

name: Noise : Caustic
purpose: Not noise in the lattice sense at all: a sum of sine sheets, each rotated by an equal share of a full turn, then sharpened by a power and lifted by a gain until the peaks flatten against the top of the range.
situation: A regular interference pattern of bright ridges and dark gaps, laid out on a fixed geometry rather than a random one.

name: Noise : Curl
purpose: The one noise in the family that answers with a real vector rather than one scalar sampled three times.
situation: A direction field that should swirl rather than point at or away from anything, read by a tensor or written to a vector attribute.

name: Noise3D Definition
purpose: The base every Noise : node inherits.
situation: Reading any Noise : page and needing to know what Frequency, Seed, Scale or Blend Mode do, or what two noises on one pin add up to.

name: Noise : FBM
purpose: A generator, not a modifier.
situation: Layered Perlin whose octaves need shaping into ridges, bulges or a warped domain rather than plain summation.

name: Noise : Flow
purpose: Perlin with the corner gradients spun in place.
situation: A field that has to evolve smoothly across a sequence of runs rather than jump to a fresh pattern each time.

name: Noise : Gabor
purpose: A sum of Gabor kernels, each a cosine wave running along Direction under a bell-shaped envelope, scattered through the lattice.
situation: A field with a grain to it, running along an axis you choose rather than isotropic in every direction.

name: Noise : Marble
purpose: A sine wave along one axis, or out from the origin, whose phase is pushed around by Perlin turbulence.
situation: Banded structure with a direction to it: veins, grain, strata, rings.

name: Noise : OpenSimplex2
purpose: Gradient noise sharing Noise : Simplex exact lattice skew and differing in what happens inside the cell.
situation: The same job as Simplex, from a denser gradient set and without the corner-selection branch.

name: Noise : Perlin
purpose: Gradient noise on the plain cubic lattice, and the reference point the rest of the family is easiest to read against.
situation: A smooth, unremarkable spatial field to drive a mask, an offset or a density falloff.

name: Noise : Simplex
purpose: Gradient noise on a skewed tetrahedral lattice rather than a cubic one, reading four corners per sample where Noise : Perlin reads eight.
situation: The same job as Perlin, on a lattice whose cell shape does not line up with the world axes.

name: Noise : Spots
purpose: One shaped blob per lattice cell against a flat zero background.
situation: Discrete marks scattered on a background, where the background has to be exactly zero rather than merely low.

name: Noise : Swiss (Erosion)
purpose: Layered Perlin that feeds its own slope back into itself.
situation: Layered noise that should read as carved rather than piled, with detail unevenly distributed by slope.

name: Noise : Tiling
purpose: A generator, not a modifier: Perlin-style gradient noise whose corner lookups wrap, so the field repeats exactly on a box you choose.
situation: A field that has to repeat over a known box without a visible join, for tiled layouts or a pattern that must line up with a grid.

name: Noise : Value
purpose: Lattice noise with no gradients: one hashed value per lattice corner, interpolated.
situation: A smooth field whose extrema sit on lattice corners rather than between them, or a cheaper stand-in for gradient noise.

name: Noise : Voronoi
purpose: The same cellular lattice as Noise : Worley, Euclidean only, with four output modes and one setting Worley does not have: Smoothness, which blends the competing cell distances into each other instead of taking the nearest outright.
situation: Cell-shaped structure whose boundaries should be soft rather than creased, or a flat random value per cell.

name: Noise : White
purpose: One hashed value per lattice cell, held flat across the whole cell.
situation: A blocky random field, or a per-region random draw keyed to position rather than to point order.

name: Noise : Worley
purpose: Cellular noise built from the distance to a jittered feature point per lattice cell.
situation: Cell-shaped structure keyed to position: stone, cracks, bubbles, or a per-region random draw with organic boundaries.

name: Filter : Noise
purpose: Turns a noise field into a pass or fail.
situation: Elements should be kept or dropped in coherent patches decided by where they sit in the world.

name: Normalize
purpose: Turns each point's position into a figure between 0 and 1 across the data's own bounds, and writes it to an attribute.
situation: A gradient, mask or lookup that should follow the extent of whatever data arrives rather than fixed world coordinates.

name: Filter : Compare (Numeric)
purpose: Compares one number read on the element against a second number, either a constant you type or another attribute on that same element.
situation: A number already written onto the points, and the next node should act only where it sits above, below or near a threshold.

name: Filter : Compare Nearest (Numeric)
purpose: Judges each element by a number carried on the closest point of another dataset.
situation: Two datasets in play, where the number deciding each element of the first one is stored on the second.

name: Filter : Self Compare (Numeric)
purpose: Compares one attribute against itself at a second index of the same dataset.
situation: An ordered dataset where the question is how a value changes from one element to the next, or how each element stands against one reference element.

name: Path : Offset
purpose: Moves every point of a path sideways, to lay a parallel run beside it or to grow and shrink a closed shape.
situation: A path needs a second run holding a fixed distance beside it, or a closed shape needs to be inflated or inset.

name: Collection | Omni
purpose: Holds entries of every registered type in one weighted list.
situation: One weighted library has to draw across asset kinds, or a set of single-type collections needs folding into one pool.

name: Average
purpose: Splits the corner.
situation: A path with corners, where whatever is placed at a corner should straddle it rather than agree with one of its two segments.

name: Orient Operation
purpose: The half the three orient rules share, whichever one is picked from the Orientation dropdown on Path : Orient.
situation: Reading one of the three rules and needing to know which part of the resulting rotation is the rule's doing and which part is the node's.

name: Look At
purpose: Aims at a target instead of working one out from the shape of the path.
situation: Points along a path that have to face something the path knows nothing about, a fixed location in the level or a direction an earlier node worked out.

name: Path : Orient
purpose: Sets each point's rotation from the shape of the path around it.
situation: A path whose points came from somewhere that did not care about rotation, and something is about to be placed along it that does.

name: Weighted
purpose: Average with a lean toward the segment the path leaves on.
situation: A corner where the bisector reads as lagging behind the turn, and the direction the path leaves on should carry more of the result.

name: Cluster : Pack
purpose: Folds each cluster into one point dataset, so it can go where a pair of pins cannot: into a PCG Data Asset, through a boundary that carries one dataset, into storage.
situation: A cluster has to be written into a PCG Data Asset and read back later.

name: Partition Identifier
purpose: Names the partition cell a position sits in, as a string a graph can key on.
situation: A partitioned generation that has to address cells by name, whether to key streaming, to build asset identifiers per cell, or to reason about its own neighbours.

name: Cluster : Partition Vtx
purpose: Gives every Edges dataset a Vtx dataset of its own.
situation: A cluster came out of a generator as one Vtx dataset and several Edges datasets, and something downstream has to treat each component as a dataset in its own right.

name: Path × Path Crossings
purpose: Finds where path segments cross other path segments, on the pin's other paths or on the same path, and puts a point at each crossing.
situation: Two sets of paths overlap and the overlap has to become addressable, as points that carry which way the other path was going.

name: Pathfinding : Edges
purpose: Routes from seeds to goals across a cluster's edges.
situation: A network of connections already exists, and routes have to be traced through it between two sets of points.

name: Pathfinding : Grow Paths
purpose: Walks outward from seeds with no destination in mind.
situation: A structure has to spread out from a handful of starting vertices and the shape it reaches is the answer, with no target to aim at.

name: Pathfinding : Navmesh
purpose: Routes between seeds and goals over the level's navigation mesh instead of a cluster.
situation: Routes have to respect level geometry and navigation volumes rather than a network you built yourself.

name: Pathfinding : Plot Edges
purpose: Routes through waypoints already in order.
situation: The waypoints a route has to visit are known and ordered, and what needs solving is the connections between them.

name: Pathfinding : Plot Navmesh
purpose: Routes through waypoints already in order, over the level's navigation mesh.
situation: A patrol or a delivery order is authored as a sequence of places, and the level geometry has to decide how to get between them.

name: Path : Hatch
purpose: Rules a bundle of parallel lines across a closed shape and keeps only the parts that fall inside it, each kept part coming back as its own short path.
situation: A closed outline has to be filled with regular runs that stop at its border, and the border is not a rectangle.

name: Path : Insert
purpose: Threads loose points into a path at the place they belong in its order.
situation: Points produced somewhere else, doors, junctions or markers, that have to become part of a path already running past them.

name: Path Processor Settings
purpose: The shared surface behind every node that takes a path on a pin labelled Paths.
situation: A path node returned fewer datasets than went in, or handed one back untouched, and the question is whether it refused the short ones.

name: Path : Reduce
purpose: Takes points out of a path and writes a pair of tangent vectors on the ones left, chosen so a curve drawn through them still follows the run the removed points described.
situation: A dense path that has to survive as a handful of control points, most often because a spline or a curve system is what reads it next.

name: Path : Slide
purpose: Moves each point along the path toward one of its two neighbours, by a fraction of that gap or by a fixed distance.
situation: Points sit on the corners of a run and need to sit part way along the segments instead, without losing the ability to put them back.

name: Path : Solidify
purpose: Turns each segment of a path into one oriented box.
situation: A path that has to become a physical run of geometry, pipes, walls or rails, where each piece has to reach exactly from one point to the next.

name: Staging : Spline Mesh
purpose: Path segments get meshes, deformed along them.
situation: A path has to become a continuous run of geometry, with the mesh for each span chosen from a collection.

name: Path : Spline Mesh (Simple)
purpose: Bends a mesh along every segment of a path, spawning one spline mesh component per segment on an actor.
situation: A run of points has to become continuous geometry in the level, with the mesh bending to follow the run.

name: Path : Stitch
purpose: Joins separate paths into longer ones by their ends.
situation: A set of path fragments that describe one continuous run and have to be handed downstream as one.

name: Path : To Clusters
purpose: Turns ordered points into connected ones.
situation: Several paths were routed across the same site and now have to be read as one network, with the places they touch treated as junctions.

name: Collection | PCGDataAsset
purpose: A weighted list of PCG data assets, where a row can also be a level.
situation: A level was dressed by hand, and it needs to become one row that a single pick can place.

name: Staging : Load PCGData
purpose: The spawn route for picks that resolved to a PCG data entry.
situation: A staged dataset whose picks name PCG data entries, and the arrangements those entries hold have to come back into the graph at each point.

name: Cluster : Pick Closest
purpose: Narrows a batch of clusters down to the ones nearest a set of points you place, and keeps, drops or marks each cluster on that verdict.
situation: A generator produced clusters across a whole site and only the ones near a handful of placed markers should go downstream.

name: Picker : Ranges from Set
purpose: Reads its spans from data rather than holding them.
situation: Blocks of consecutive entries worked out upstream and written as pairs, that now have to drive a node taking pickers.

name: Picker : Indices from Set
purpose: Reads its indices from data rather than holding them.
situation: A selection worked out earlier in the graph and written to an attribute, that now has to drive a node taking pickers.

name: Picker : Range
purpose: Names a contiguous span of indices, authored on the node.
situation: A block of consecutive entries, described by where the block starts and ends rather than by listing it.

name: Picker : Constant
purpose: Names one index, authored on the node.
situation: One entry out of a set whose size is not known when the graph is authored, named by its position rather than by anything it carries.

name: Picker Definition
purpose: The base every Picker : node inherits.
situation: Reading any Picker : page and needing to know what Treat As Normalized changes, or what happens to a pick that lands outside the collection.

name: Filter : Picker
purpose: Turns an index selection into an ordinary filter verdict.
situation: The elements to act on are known by where they sit in the data rather than by anything they carry.

name: Points Processor Settings
purpose: The base almost every point-processing node inherits, sitting between the root settings and the node itself.
situation: Reading a node page and needing to know which of its settings are its own and which reach it from the point-processing base.

name: Points to Bounds
purpose: Reduces a whole dataset to the box that contains it.
situation: A group of points that needs to be treated as one object downstream, or measured without being changed.

name: Resources
purpose: Asset loading is the cost that lands at spawn time, and this node is where you move it.
situation: A graph spawns from collections whose content is not yet loaded, and the streaming cost has to land somewhere other than the middle of generation.

name: Filter : Primitive Overlap
purpose: Asks whether each element's own box touches the collision geometry of primitive components handed to it on a pin.
situation: A set of colliders marks where content belongs or does not, and every element has to be judged against them.

name: Probe : Anisotropic
purpose: Sixteen bearings, 22.5 degrees apart, one connection each.
situation: Connectivity that should follow fixed compass bearings rather than proximity, on a layout that is flat or projected flat.

name: Probe : Bitmasks
purpose: Probe : Anisotropic with a bearing set you author.
situation: A connectivity pattern that has to follow one specific set of bearings, authored once in an asset and reused across several graphs.

name: G-Probe : Chain/Path
purpose: Puts the points in an order and joins each one to the next, which is the one probe in the family that turns a set into a sequence.
situation: A set that has to be walked as a single sequence, where the order comes from an attribute or from the shape of the set itself.

name: Probe : Closest
purpose: Proximity with a cap.
situation: A scatter that should become a cluster on nothing more than proximity, with a per-point say in how many connections each point reaches for.

name: G-Probe : DBSCAN
purpose: Sorts a scatter by local density and connects the dense parts of it.
situation: A scatter of dense clumps with thin strays between them, where the clumps should become clusters and the strays should fall out.

name: Probe : Direction
purpose: One connection per point, along an axis you name.
situation: Connectivity that has to follow an axis rather than proximity: aligned rows, oriented chains, a flow read from an attribute.

name: Probe Definition
purpose: The base every Probe : and G-Probe : node inherits.
situation: Reading any probe page and needing to know what its Search Radius means, or which of the two prefixes is in hand and what that changes.

name: G-Probe : Anisotropic
purpose: Ranks candidates by a distance that is stretched along three axes, so a chosen direction reads as closer than it is and wins the ranking.
situation: A scatter that has to connect along a grain, where plain nearest-neighbour would join across the grain as readily as along it.

name: G-Probe : Gradient Flow
purpose: Reads a number off every point and connects along the way that number changes.
situation: A scalar spread across a scatter, where the connections should follow which way that value climbs and falls.

name: G-Probe : Hub & Spoke
purpose: Promotes a handful of points to hubs and attaches everything else to them, which turns a flat scatter into two tiers.
situation: A scatter that has to route through a small number of collection points instead of joining neighbour to neighbour.

name: Probe : Index
purpose: The one probe that never looks at a position.
situation: An ordered point set that has to be wired by its ordering rather than by where its points ended up.

name: G-Probe : KNN
purpose: Joins every point to its nearest few, with no distance limit anywhere in the rule.
situation: A scatter with uneven spacing that has to come out connected everywhere, where a fixed radius would leave the thin regions bare while over-connecting the dense ones.

name: G-Probe : Level Set
purpose: Connects points whose value on a chosen scalar sits close together, and leaves the rest alone.
situation: A scalar spread across a scatter where points at a similar level should join up and points across levels should stay apart.

name: Probe : Numeric Compare
purpose: Probe : Closest with a value test on top.
situation: Joining points only where a numeric attribute stands in a chosen relation between the two, on top of proximity.

name: Probe : RNG
purpose: RNG here stands for Relative Neighborhood Graph, and has nothing to do with random numbers.
situation: A scatter that has to become an evenly connected mesh with no redundant connections, without tuning a connection count by hand.

name: G-Probe : Greedy Spanner
purpose: Thins a set down to the fewest connections that still leave every pair reachable by a route no longer than Stretch Factor times the straight line between them.
situation: A set that has to stay navigable end to end while carrying as few connections as the routing quality allows.

name: Probe : Tensor
purpose: Probe : Direction with the axis sampled from a field instead of set on the node.
situation: Connectivity that has to follow a field: flow lines along a spline, a swirl around a pole, an axis that changes across the set.

name: G-Probe : Theta Graph
purpose: Fans a ring of cones around each point and keeps one connection per cone, which caps how many connections a point starts and spreads them evenly around it.
situation: A scatter that has to come out evenly connected in every direction around each point, with a hard ceiling on how many connections any one point starts.

name: ✱ Probe : Orbital
purpose: A probe that connects points along the directions an Orbital Set defines, so the cluster it helps build is already shaped like the set a solve will use.
situation: A loose point cloud that has to become a cluster whose connections line up with a bonding direction set.

name: Property Blueprint Library
purpose: Backs the Blueprint nodes that read and write one property by name on a PCGEx Property Collection component.
situation: A Blueprint needs the value of a named property off an actor's property collection, or needs to write one before something else reads that actor.

name: PCGEx Property Collection
purpose: Puts a property collection on an actor.
situation: A placed or spawned actor should carry typed data that the collection built from it, or a graph that resolves it, can read back.

name: Property Schema
purpose: Declares a set of named, typed properties once so several collections, components and nodes can carry the same fields without redeclaring them.
situation: Several collections or components need the same property fields, and the declaration should live in one place instead of being copied into each of them.

name: Radius Fitting
purpose: The fitting rule whose collision shape is a single number.
situation: Spacing Vtx whose footprint one number describes well enough, or whose size varies per Vtx and already lives in an attribute.

name: Radius
purpose: Averages every other point of the same path that falls inside a sphere around each point.
situation: A path that folds back on itself or crowds against its own earlier run, where points close in space should agree with each other whatever their place in the order.

name: Filter : Random
purpose: Gives every element its own coin toss.
situation: A share of the elements should be kept at random, and which ones may not shift when the set around them changes.

name: Filter : Random (Ratio)
purpose: The count is settled before any element is looked at, as a share of the set or as a flat figure, and then that many are drawn.
situation: Exactly a tenth of a set has to be marked, and which tenth does not matter as long as the count holds.

name: Filter : Raycast
purpose: Asks whether there is geometry in a given direction from each element, and how far away it sits.
situation: Elements should survive only where something solid sits in a given direction, or only where the gap before it is short enough.

name: Break
purpose: A subgraph that calls itself has no stop condition of its own, and Break supplies one.
situation: A recursive subgraph that has to terminate after a bounded number of passes, or as soon as the data it is chewing through runs out.

name: Reduce Data
purpose: Collapses one @Data attribute, read once per input dataset, into a single value.
situation: Twenty datasets each carry a per-dataset value and the graph needs one number standing for all of them.

name: Cluster : Refine
purpose: Removes edges from a cluster by a rule.
situation: A generator connected far more than it should have, and one rule has to cut it back to the structure the rest of the graph is built around.

name: Refresh Seed
purpose: Rewrites each point's Seed from where the point is, so randomness downstream becomes a property of the location rather than of the order points happen to arrive in.
situation: Regenerating the graph reshuffles variation that should have stayed put, because the seeds came from index order.

name: Relax Operation
purpose: The half every relaxation shares, whichever rule is picked from the Relaxing dropdown on Cluster : Relax.
situation: Reading one of the relaxations and needing to know which parts of its behaviour are its own and which reach it from here.

name: Cluster : Relax
purpose: Moves Vtx while every connection stays exactly as it was.
situation: A generated cluster whose Vtx sit exactly where the source points were, and the layout needs to open up without a single edge being added, removed or re-routed.

name: Path : Resample
purpose: Spaces a path's points evenly along its own length.
situation: A path whose spacing came from how it was built rather than from what it has to drive, a spline conversion or a pathfinding result being the usual sources.

name: Reverse Order
purpose: Flips the point order of a dataset, which for a path means reversing the direction it runs.
situation: Paths that came from several sources and need one consistent direction or winding before anything reads them as sequences.

name: Sample : Inside Path
purpose: The sampler that runs the other way round.
situation: Authored outlines that need to know what landed inside them, whether that is a count, an average, or a single representative point.

name: Sample : Nearest Bounds
purpose: Samples the target points whose bounds a point is standing inside.
situation: Points scattered over regions that were authored as bounded targets, where what each point should inherit depends on which region it landed in.

name: Sample : Nearest Path
purpose: Samples paths from your points, and by default it samples them as enclosed areas rather than as lines.
situation: Points that need to know which authored outline they fall within, and how near its boundary they are.

name: Sample : Nearest Point
purpose: Reads a second point set from each of your points and writes back what it found there.
situation: Points that need a value carried over from a scattered reference set, whether that is the single nearest one or a falloff across everything in range.

name: Sample : Nearest Spline
purpose: Reads real splines rather than paths made of points.
situation: Points that need to align to, or measure against, a spline component rather than a path the graph built.

name: Sample : Nearest Surface
purpose: Finds the closest point on real collision geometry, for each of your points.
situation: Scattered points that need to sit on, or measure against, geometry that exists in the level rather than in the graph.

name: Cluster : Sample Neighbors
purpose: Runs the neighbour samplers over a cluster.
situation: A cluster whose Vtx should each learn something from what they are connected to, rather than from what is near them.

name: Sample : Overlap Stats
purpose: Measures how much each point is crowded by points from other datasets, and writes the answer without removing anything.
situation: Several scattered layers that are expected to conflict, and a need to see where and how badly before deciding what to cull.

name: Sample : Sockets
purpose: Reads the sockets authored on a static mesh and outputs them as points.
situation: Points already carry the asset path of the mesh they stand for, and something has to land on that mesh's authored sockets.

name: Sample : Line Trace
purpose: Fires a ray from each point and reports what it hit.
situation: Points that need to land on whatever is beneath them, or to answer whether anything stands between them and somewhere else.

name: Sample : Texture
purpose: Reads texture values at coordinates the points already carry.
situation: Points carrying UV coordinates that need a mask, a heightmap or a colour read out of the texture those coordinates belong to.

name: Sample : Vtx by ID
purpose: Reconnects points to the cluster vertices they came from.
situation: Points carry an id copied off a cluster earlier in the graph and now need transforms or attributes from the vertices those ids name.

name: Cluster : Repair
purpose: Rebuilds a cluster from the endpoint ids its two halves carry, and emits whatever still holds together.
situation: Cluster data came back from vanilla nodes and the cluster nodes downstream either refuse it or read the wrong vertices.

name: A*
purpose: The one algorithm here that asks the heuristics where the goal is.
situation: A point-to-point route across a cluster where the heuristics have some sense of direction, and examining the whole cluster to find it would be wasted work.

name: Bellman-Ford
purpose: The algorithm for a cost model that can go below zero.
situation: A stack where one heuristic is weighted negatively to reward a feature rather than penalise it, and the routes the other algorithms return skip past the rewarded edges.

name: Bidirectional
purpose: Two searches instead of one, started at either end and grown until they touch.
situation: Long routes across a large cluster, where a single frontier grown from the seed would sweep most of the cluster before it arrived.

name: Dijkstra
purpose: Spends more of the cluster to remove the one thing that can bend A* off course.
situation: A cost model whose weights are the point of the setup, where a route that merely arrives is worth less than the route those weights actually describe.

name: Filter : Segment Cross
purpose: Judges each element by the segment it starts, and asks whether that segment crosses any of the shapes on the Targets pin.
situation: A run of points has to be marked wherever the line between two of them passes through a boundary.

name: Filter : Segment Length
purpose: Measures the straight-line distance from each element to another element of the same dataset, picked by index, and compares it against a threshold.
situation: An ordered point set where spacing decides what survives, or where a gap has to be found.

name: Selector Modifier : Anti-Repeat
purpose: Breaks visible repetition in a sequence of picks without changing what the collection offers.
situation: Points picked in order along a path or a row, where two neighbours landing on the same entry is what reads as wrong.

name: Selector : Best Fit
purpose: Answers the per-point pick by size.
situation: Points whose bounds were sized upstream, and a collection whose entries span a range of sizes that should line up with them.

name: Selector Modifier : Cascade
purpose: Chains selectors so a point one of them cannot answer falls through to the next.
situation: A picking rule that answers for most of a dataset and leaves a remainder it has no entry for, where that remainder still needs one.

name: Selector : Classic
purpose: Answers the per-point pick with the plain strategies: a roll that follows the entries' authored weights, a roll that ignores them, or a number read per point and used as a position in the entry list.
situation: A collection whose authored weights already say how often each entry should appear, or a graph carrying a per-point number that names the entry outright.

name: Selector : Closest Match
purpose: Answers the per-point pick by matching values.
situation: Points already carrying the values that should decide their asset, and a collection whose entries declare properties of the same name.

name: Selector : Curve-Remapped Weight
purpose: Answers the per-point pick with a gradient.
situation: Points carrying one measured value, and a collection whose entries should take over from one another across that value's range.

name: Selector : Density-Weighted
purpose: Answers the per-point pick with a scalar the point already carries.
situation: A collection whose weighting should be felt strongly in some places and barely at all in others, with a per-point scalar already saying where.

name: Selector Definition
purpose: The abstract base every Selector and Selector Modifier inherits.
situation: Reading any selector page and needing to know what its Sub Distribution, Category, Seed or Priority settings do, since those are the same on every one of them.

name: Selector : Interleaved
purpose: Answers the per-point pick from a position in a sequence, with no roll involved.
situation: An ordered run of points where the entry proportions have to hold and repeats must not bunch together.

name: Selector : Noise Field
purpose: Answers the per-point pick from where the point is.
situation: A scatter that should read as regions, where one stretch of ground favours one set of assets and the next stretch favours another.

name: Selector Modifier : Quota
purpose: Puts a budget on each entry and enforces it around another selector.
situation: A collection holding a few entries that must appear a fixed number of times across a scatter, with the rest free to fill in around them.

name: Selector : Range-Based
purpose: Answers the per-point pick by containment: each entry declares the band of values it covers, and a point picks among the entries whose bands contain its value.
situation: A collection whose entries were authored with the band of values each one covers, and points carrying the value that has to land in one of them.

name: Self Pruning
purpose: Thins a dataset by removing points that overlap each other.
situation: A scatter dense enough that instances would intersect, needing thinning without a fixed grid or a re-scatter.

name: Settings
purpose: The settings every PCGEx node carries, whatever it does.
situation: A node behaving oddly around threading, caching or warnings, where the cause is in the shared block rather than in the node.

name: ShapeBuilder Definition
purpose: The base every Shape sub-node inherits, and the page for the settings they all share.
situation: Reading one of the Shape nodes and needing to know which of its settings are its own and which reach it from here.

name: Path : Shift
purpose: Rotates a path's data around a chosen point, so that point's values end up at the front and everything before it wraps to the back.
situation: A closed path whose seam falls in the wrong place, where the run is right and only the point it is written down from is wrong.

name: Path : Shrink
purpose: Eats a path in from its ends.
situation: Runs that have to stop short of whatever they lead to, a road ending before a building or a cable stopping clear of its anchor.

name: Cluster : Simplify
purpose: Takes Vtx out of a cluster without changing what it connects.
situation: A cluster came out of a generator or a mesh import carrying far more Vtx along its runs than the connectivity needs.

name: Collection | Skinned Mesh
purpose: A weighted library of skinned meshes, row for row the Mesh Collection with a skinned asset in place of the static one.
situation: The library holds skeletal meshes, and the picks have to reach a spawner that renders skinned geometry.

name: Staging Data (Skinned)
purpose: Skinned-mesh spawning is what the vanilla Skinned Mesh Spawner already does, and this is what teaches it to read staged picks.
situation: A staged dataset reaches a Skinned Mesh Spawner, and the skeletal meshes have to come out with the descriptors and tags their collections authored.

name: Smoothing
purpose: The half the two smoothing rules share.
situation: Reading **Moving Average** or **Radius** and needing to know which half of the result the rule decides and which half the node above it decides.

name: Path : Smooth
purpose: Pulls each point toward the points around it.
situation: A path whose run between points wobbles, where the overall shape is right and the point-to-point noise is not.

name: Staging : Load Sockets
purpose: Turns the sockets baked into collection entries into points.
situation: A staged set of props has to grow accessories at their authored attachment points, one per socket, without disturbing the props.

name: Sort Data
purpose: Reorders the datasets on a pin rather than the points inside them, comparing one @Data value per dataset with the same Sorting Rule sub-nodes that Sort Points uses.
situation: A pin carrying many datasets whose order was decided by upstream wiring, feeding something that reads them in order.

name: Sorting Rule
purpose: One rule in an ordering.
situation: An ordering that needs more than one criterion, or a tie-break behind a value with repeats.

name: Spatial Triage
purpose: Sorts datasets into three piles by where they sit relative to one reference box: this one is mine, this one straddles the border, this one is somebody else's problem.
situation: A partitioned generation where each cell has to decide, cheaply and before doing any real work, which of the incoming datasets it is responsible for.

name: Spawn Dynamic Mesh
purpose: Puts a dynamic mesh into the level, with more control over the component than the stock node offers.
situation: A generated mesh that has to exist in the level with specific component settings, rather than merely as graph data.

name: Spline to Path
purpose: Turns vanilla spline data into path data, one point per control point.
situation: A spline needs to go through path nodes, and the curve between its control points is not what the operation cares about.

name: Path : Split
purpose: Cuts one path into several at the points a filter picks out.
situation: One path has to become several, and where it breaks is decided by a per-point test rather than by a count or a distance.

name: Staging : Type Filter
purpose: Routes staged points by what their pick resolved to.
situation: An Omni Collection staged one mixed dataset, and the meshes must reach the mesh spawner while the actors reach Staging : Spawn Actors.

name: Staging : Fitting
purpose: Fitting normally runs inside Staging : Distribute, as the pick is made.
situation: A Variant Collection swap replaced entries whose footprint differs from the originals, so the transforms still describe a fit solved against the old bounds.

name: Staging : Spawn Level
purpose: Places whole levels at staged points.
situation: A level was dressed by hand and listed as one entry in a Level Collection, and every point that picked it has to become that arrangement in the world.

name: Staging : Load Properties
purpose: Staged points know which entry they picked and nothing else.
situation: A cost, a curve or a footprint authored on the collection entries has to drive point math downstream, and the points carry only their pick.

name: Staging : Load Sketch
purpose: Prints Cluster Sketch assets onto target points, one cluster per target, inheriting each target's transform.
situation: A library of hand-authored pieces has to distribute over points like any other staged asset.

name: Staging : Spawn Actors
purpose: Puts real actors in the level from staged picks.
situation: An Actor Collection has been staged over a point layout, and those actors now have to exist in the level as content the graph creates and cleans up.

name: Staging : Swap
purpose: Rewrites picks that a staging node already made, so one layout can spawn several sets of assets.
situation: One staged layout has to ship as several themes, and every theme must land on the same points in the same places.

name: State : Point
purpose: One named condition, wrapped so that Write States can fold it into a flag mask.
situation: A condition that several later nodes need to test, cheap enough to answer once and carry as a bit rather than re-evaluating per consumer.

name: Filter : Compare (String)
purpose: Compares one text value read on the element against a second, either a constant you type or another attribute on that same element.
situation: Text already written onto the points, and the next node should act only where it matches, contains or outranks a second string.

name: Filter : Compare Nearest (String)
purpose: Judges each element by a text value carried on the closest point of another dataset.
situation: Two datasets in play, where the label deciding each element of the first one is stored on the second.

name: Filter : Regex
purpose: Tests one text value on the element against a regular expression.
situation: Text on the points whose acceptable shapes cannot be written as one equality, prefix or substring test.

name: Filter : Self Compare (String)
purpose: Compares one text attribute against itself at a second index of the same dataset.
situation: An ordered dataset where the question is how a label changes from one element to the next, or how each element reads against one reference element.

name: Structural Grammar
purpose: The asset a grammar-driven growth runs.
situation: A structure that has a recipe, where the order things get built in is part of the design.

name: Path : Subdivide
purpose: Adds points inside the segments of a path and leaves the points already there exactly where they were.
situation: A path whose points sit too far apart for whatever reads it next, deformation, sampling or spawning, where the run itself is already right.

name: Inherit Last
purpose: Every invented point in a gap comes out holding a copy of the point the gap ends at.
situation: Points invented along a segment should carry the values of the point ahead of them, with nothing mixed in from behind.

name: Inherit First
purpose: Every invented point in a gap comes out holding a copy of the point the gap starts at.
situation: Points invented along a segment should carry the values of the point behind them, with nothing mixed in from ahead.

name: Sub-Point Blending Operation
purpose: Every path node that invents points has to decide what those points are worth, and this family is where that decision lives.
situation: Points a path node invented came back carrying values nobody chose, and the setting that chose them is that node's `Blending` dropdown.

name: Interpolate
purpose: The one sub-node in the family that gives each invented point a weight of its own.
situation: The points a node invented along a segment should carry a value that ramps from the point the gap starts at to the point it ends at.

name: No Blending
purpose: Skips the blend.
situation: The consumer already wrote the values the invented points should carry, and a blend would write over them.

name: Data Filter : Tag Check
purpose: Asks whether a dataset carries a tag, and answers for the dataset as a whole.
situation: Datasets marked upstream by whichever branch produced them, where only one of those markings should carry on.

name: Data Filter : Tag Value
purpose: Compares what a Key:Value tag carries, and answers for the dataset as a whole.
situation: Datasets stamped upstream with a graded value, where only the ones past a threshold should reach the next stage.

name: Tangents (Base)
purpose: Tangent rules decide, per point, how a curve arrives at that point and how it leaves it.
situation: A path is about to become a spline or a run of spline meshes, and the curve running between its points has to be decided.

name: Filter : Tensor Dot
purpose: Turns alignment with a tensor field into a pass or fail.
situation: A field is already shaping the scene, and the next node should touch only the elements facing along it, or only the ones facing across it.

name: Tensor Definition
purpose: The base every Tensor : node inherits.
situation: Reading any tensor page and needing to know what its Potency, Weight and falloff curves are doing, or how far one effector reaches.

name: Tensor Sampler (Default)
purpose: The sampler every consumer starts on, and the base the other three extend.
situation: Reading a field that changes little between one step and the next, or working out what the other samplers are spending their extra reads on.

name: Tensor Sampler (Adaptive RK)
purpose: Measures how sharply the field is turning before it commits to a step, then walks that step in as many four-reading passes as the turn rate calls for.
situation: A field that runs smooth over most of its extent and turns hard in a few places, where a step short enough for the bends would be wasted on everything else.

name: Tensor Sampler (RK4)
purpose: Reads the field four times in a chain and answers with where a step lands, rather than with the direction sitting under the probe.
situation: An extrusion through a curving field is cutting the corners and ending up outside the streamline it started on.

name: Tensor Sampler (Six Points)
purpose: Reads the field in six places around the probe and averages them, so detail finer than the distance between them stops reaching the answer.
situation: A noise tensor in the stack is making an extrusion wander from step to step, and what is wanted is the trend under the grain.

name: Tensors Transform
purpose: Walks points through a field without turning them into paths.
situation: A scatter already exists and should be pushed, combed or swirled by a field instead of being regenerated from it.

name: Texture Param
purpose: Names one texture parameter on a material and says what a consumer should write when it finds it.
situation: Materials that expose a mask or a heightmap under a known parameter name, and a graph that wants that texture's values on its points.

name: Filter : Time
purpose: Reads a point's location as a position along a path.
situation: Which elements survive depends on how far along a path they sit rather than on how close to it they are.

name: Topology : Cluster Surface
purpose: Fills in the faces of a cluster.
situation: A cluster whose cells were built deliberately, and now need to exist as a mesh rather than as a diagram.

name: Topology : Path Surface
purpose: Fills a path in.
situation: An authored or generated outline that should become a solid piece of ground, water or floor.

name: Topology : Point Surface
purpose: Turns a loose scatter into a surface, by triangulating the points themselves.
situation: Scattered points that should read as ground, water or any continuous sheet, without a cluster having been built first.

name: Transform Points
purpose: Offsets, rotates and scales points by a random amount within a range you set.
situation: Placed points that read as too regular, needing controlled variation without a scatter being redone.

name: Tuple
purpose: Authors a small table on the node and emits it as an attribute set.
situation: A graph needs a handful of named, typed values that belong together as rows, authored in one place instead of assembled from separate constant nodes.

name: Uber Branch
purpose: Sorts whole datasets down numbered pins by asking a stack of filters about each one.
situation: One pin carrying a mixed pile of datasets that each need a different treatment downstream, with the choice expressed as filter rules rather than as tags.

name: Uber Filter (Cascade)
purpose: Sorts elements into buckets by which condition they satisfy first.
situation: Several conditions overlap and each element should be handled by exactly one of them.

name: Uber Filter (Data)
purpose: Keeps or drops whole datasets.
situation: Several datasets arrive on one pin and only the ones meeting a condition should carry on.

name: Uber Filter
purpose: Turns a filter stack's verdicts into data.
situation: A condition decides where elements go next, and both the passes and the failures have work waiting for them.

name: Uber Noise
purpose: Turns a stack of Noise : sub-nodes into an attribute.
situation: Points that already exist need a spatial value, whether that is a fresh mask attribute or a nudge applied to something they already carry.

name: Cluster : Unpack
purpose: Splits a packed cluster back into a Vtx dataset and an Edges dataset and pairs them again.
situation: A cluster is being read back out of a PCG Data Asset and has to become two pins again.

name: Valency : Staging
purpose: The step between a resolved result and something that spawns.
situation: A finished Valency result that has to become meshes, actors or level instances.

name: Backtracking Solver
purpose: The one strategy that takes a decision back.
situation: A tight library where the other strategies leave holes you believe are avoidable.

name: Valency : Grow Cluster
purpose: Grows onto a cluster whose modules are already resolved, starting from whatever connectors those modules left open.
situation: A solved layout that needs things attached to it, where the attachments should follow from what is already there rather than from a fresh set of seeds.

name: Valency : Grow Points
purpose: Builds structure that did not exist before it ran.
situation: A handful of points that have to become buildings, corridors, pipe runs or vegetation, with nothing to fill in and everything to create.

name: Bonding Rules Asset
purpose: The module library, and the only Valency asset a PCG graph consumes directly.
situation: The library a solve or a growth draws its modules from.

name: Valency : Solve
purpose: Fills a cluster you already have: one module per Vtx, chosen so that every orbital facing a neighbour accepts what sits there.
situation: A cluster carrying orbital data that has to become an arrangement of modules obeying a library of bonding rules.

name: ✱ Filter : Connectors
purpose: The connector-side sibling of the orbitals filter, asking which of a point's connectors are still open and which a structural connection already spent.
situation: Aiming a second growth pass at the parts of a structure that still have a free socket.

name: Connector Set
purpose: The connector type table, the compatibility between every pair of types, and the polarity rules.
situation: Deciding what kinds of connection exist and which of them accept each other.

name: Constraint Solver
purpose: Visits positions in the same fewest-candidates order the default does, and spends its effort on hitting minimum spawns.
situation: A library with minimums that have to be met, where the result must contain specific things and not merely be valid.

name: Entropy Solver
purpose: The strategy Valency : Solve runs unless you pick another.
situation: The ordinary solve: a cluster to fill from a library, with no order of your own to impose.

name: Valency : Find Bridges
purpose: Bridging as its own pass, run after the fact on a cluster whose modules are already resolved.
situation: A resolved cluster whose parts sit near each other but are not joined, and should be.

name: BFS Growth
purpose: Expands the frontier in rings: every connector at one distance from the seed is spent before any connector further out is touched.
situation: A structure that should read as a mass around its seed, filling out from the middle.

name: DFS Growth
purpose: Follows one line as far as it will go before coming back for anything else, so structures come out as tendrils and corridors rather than as a mass.
situation: Corridors, vines, pipe runs, anything whose point is to get somewhere rather than to fill a space.

name: Growth Strategy
purpose: The shared base every growth strategy is built on, and where the settings they all have in common are declared.
situation: Reading what the pattern and bridge settings on a growth strategy do, without caring which strategy is selected.

name: Random Growth
purpose: Takes any open connector, drawn uniformly, so the structure spreads without a shape of its own.
situation: Growth that should look accidental, where neither an even mass nor a long run is what you are after.

name: Valency : Lattice
purpose: Turns shapes you drew into a solve-ready cluster in one node.
situation: A layout drawn as shapes that has to become a cluster snapped to a set of bonding directions.

name: Valency : Load Properties
purpose: Puts the data authored on a cage back onto points, as ordinary attributes anything downstream can read: a material index chosen per piece, a gameplay value, a flag deciding what spawns alongside the module.
situation: Authored per-module data that has to reach the rest of a PCG graph.

name: ✱ Filter : Has Module
purpose: The simplest of the four: does this point carry a placed module.
situation: Telling the part of a result that resolved from the part that did not, in either direction.

name: ✱ Filter : Orbitals
purpose: One generic question about a point's orbital configuration, rather than a menu of canned ones: a fact, a set of orbitals to ask it over, and a comparison between the two.
situation: Selecting positions by how they sit in the structure: the ones facing outward, the ones with a neighbour on a named side, the ones whose module declared a boundary that is occupied anyway.

name: Orbital Set
purpose: The direction topology: every direction modules may bond along, and the angular tolerance for matching one.
situation: Deciding which directions a structure can connect along.

name: Pattern Asset
purpose: Authored multi-module arrangements that can be recognised in a finished result.
situation: An arrangement worth recognising after the fact: a hero piece to substitute in, or a shape later stages need to find.

name: Pattern Matcher
purpose: The matcher Valency : Find Patterns runs, picked in its details panel.
situation: Any pattern search. This is the matcher unless a project ships another.

name: Valency : Find Patterns
purpose: Looks through a finished result for arrangements you authored, and acts on every occurrence it finds.
situation: An arrangement that should become one hero piece, or a recurring shape that later stages need to be able to find.

name: Valency : Planar Partition
purpose: Finds structure in a cluster that is otherwise one undifferentiated set of positions: which floor each Vtx sits on, and which connected region of that floor it belongs to.
situation: A structure whose parts should be treated differently by floor or by space: a ground floor drawing from other modules, a stairwell capped per level, a bias that prefers the outermost region.

name: Priority Solver
purpose: Hands the decision order to you, as a per-Vtx attribute.
situation: The structure has an order you already understand and want the solve to respect.

name: ✱ Filter : Module Tag
purpose: Tests the module a point resolved to against a gameplay-tag predicate, so a result can be split by what its pieces are rather than by where they sit.
situation: Aiming a second pass at one kind of module, or partitioning a finished result by role before spawning it.

name: Valency : Write Connectors
purpose: Emits one point per connector on a finished result's resolved modules, each carrying a packed reference back to the connector it came from.
situation: A finished structure whose open sockets have to become the input of whatever comes next.

name: Valency : Write Junctions
purpose: Turns each bonded connector pair into a point, sitting where the pair meets and carrying what met there.
situation: Content that belongs at a connection rather than at a module.

name: Valency : Write Orbitals
purpose: Gives a cluster the orbital data a solve reads.
situation: A cluster you built yourself that has to become something a solve can work on.

name: Filter : Contains (Hash)
purpose: Asks whether the value an element carries also appears somewhere in a reference set you supply, for any attribute type at all.
situation: A list of allowed or forbidden values exists as data somewhere in the graph, and elements have to be kept or dropped by whether their own value is on it.

name: Collection | Variant
purpose: A Variant Collection themes other collections: it declares source collections and, per source, rows saying what a source entry resolves to instead.
situation: One distributed layout has to ship in several dressed versions, and every version differs only in which assets the same picks resolve to.

name: Verlet (Gravity)
purpose: The one relaxation with momentum.
situation: A cluster that should behave like something hanging: a rope, a cable run, a net held at a few points and left to fall.

name: Filter : Inclusion (Volume)
purpose: Answers whether each element sits inside a volume placed in the level.
situation: Volumes already block out the level, and whether an element survives depends on which of them it falls in.

name: Vtx : Amplitude
purpose: Measures how far and how evenly a Vtx's neighbours are spread around it, and writes the answer on the Vtx.
situation: A cluster where the Vtx worth treating differently are the lopsided ones: a junction whose edges all leave the same way, or one whose neighbours sit far off along one axis and close along another.

name: Vtx : Edge Angle
purpose: Measures how sharply a Vtx turns, from the angles between the edges meeting at it.
situation: Cluster Vtx that should be classified by how sharp a corner they form, for filtering junctions from straights or finding kinks.

name: Vtx : Edge Match
purpose: Names the one edge at each Vtx that best lines up with a direction you give it, and writes that edge's direction, length and indices onto the Vtx.
situation: A cluster where each Vtx needs to know which of its connections continues a heading: the edge along an authored flow vector, or the one carrying on in the direction the point already faces.

name: Vtx : Abstract
purpose: The base every Vtx : node inherits, and the page carrying what the whole family shares: the Property pin they all emit on, what the consumer hands them and when, and the two output blocks most of them are built from.
situation: Reading any Vtx : page and needing to know what its Direction and Length rows measure, which way the direction points, or what the index rows are indices into.

name: Vtx : Sorted Neighbor
purpose: Ranks each Vtx's neighbours by rules you supply, keeps the single extreme, and describes the edge that reaches it.
situation: A cluster where the interesting neighbour is settled by data rather than by geometry: the highest scored, the one holding a particular value, the one an upstream pass marked.

name: Vtx : Special Edges
purpose: Ranks each Vtx's edges by length and describes the two extremes on the Vtx: the shortest edge and the longest one.
situation: A cluster where each Vtx needs to know how far its nearest or furthest connection reaches, or how lopsided the spread of its edge lengths is.

name: Vtx : Special Neighbors
purpose: Finds the busiest and the quietest neighbour of each Vtx and describes the edge that reaches it.
situation: A cluster where a Vtx needs to point at the shape of the network next to it rather than at the nearest thing: growing toward hubs, or stepping away from dead ends.

name: Wait for PCG Data
purpose: Pulls the output of PCG components living on other actors into this graph, holding execution until they have produced it.
situation: A graph that has to consume what another actor's PCG component produced, in the same generation pass, without knowing whether that component has run yet.

name: Filter : Within Range
purpose: Tests one number against a band of values, or against a whole set of bands at once.
situation: A band of acceptable values, or several bands, where a pair of comparison filters would say the same thing twice.

name: Cluster : Edge Properties
purpose: Writes what an edge is onto the point that stands for it.
situation: Something downstream has to work on the edges themselves, whether that is filtering them by length, spawning along them, or sorting them by direction.

name: Write GUID
purpose: Gives every point a stable identity attribute, computed from the point rather than handed out in sequence.
situation: Points that have to be recognised again across regenerations, or seeded independently of the order they arrived in.

name: Write Index
purpose: Writes position-in-the-data as attributes.
situation: Anything downstream that has to know where an element sits in a sequence, or how big the sequence is, without recomputing it.

name: Path : Properties
purpose: Measures a path and writes the numbers down.
situation: Something downstream has to decide from the shape of the run: a filter on how sharp a corner is, a spacing that follows distance travelled, or a hole that has to be told apart from the outline around it.

name: Write States
purpose: Turns a stack of named conditions into one number on every point.
situation: A dataset whose points have to be classified once, several ways at a time, so everything downstream can select on the classification instead of recomputing it.

name: Path : Write Tangents
purpose: Runs a tangent rule over a path and leaves the answer on the points, as two vector attributes named ArriveTangent and LeaveTangent by default.
situation: One path feeds both a spline and a run of spline meshes, and the curve has to bend the same way in both.

name: Cluster : Vtx Properties
purpose: Writes what each Vtx's own edges add up to, onto that Vtx.
situation: A cluster where what happens next turns on the shape of each junction, and the Vtx have to carry that shape as attributes before anything can filter, sort or blend on it.

name: Zero
purpose: Returns a zero vector for both tangents at every point, and ignores the scales, since zero times anything is zero.
situation: A curve should hold its shape through the middle of a path and carry no tangent at the two ends.
